user_input: Yes, build a front end and connect it together. Context: build a FastAPI/Python 3.12 SaaS B2B account-health and churn scoring app with /predict for one account and asynchronous /batch-scoring for CSV or JSON batches of 1,000+ accounts, using last-login recency, core-feature usage frequency, and subscription tier. Use PostgreSQL. The prior clarification artifact defines the proposed SLAs and first-version exclusions.
title: SaaS Account Health Dashboard

assessment_snapshot.intro: The project brief calls for a dashboard connected to the planned account-scoring API:
bullets: FastAPI/Python 3.12 backend with PostgreSQL; current workspace has no existing application UI to match
Single-account prediction and asynchronous CSV/JSON batch scoring for 1,000+ accounts
A dashboard needs to show risk tiers and make batch job progress/results actionable for Customer Success

proposed_outcome: Create a responsive web frontend connected to the FastAPI service for single-account scoring and batch uploads, with clear job status, account risk tiers, and actionable results; use a new visual system because there is no existing interface to reproduce.

questions.title: Dashboard scope and data constraints
questions.question: What account-level fields should users enter or upload, which account actions should the UI support (for example review risk drivers, filter/sort/export results, inspect batch status), and do you have labeled historical churn data for model training/evaluation? If unsure, say so and I will recommend sensible defaults.
questions.default: Assume fields are account ID, last login date, core-feature usage count over a defined window, and subscription tier; support individual scoring, CSV/JSON batch upload, job status/results, risk filtering and CSV export; use a transparent baseline model until labeled historical churn data is available.
